discovery_notes: Follow-up 7 of B041 (397/445/478). 30 standard searches, snippet leads only. New pins: HKDL Walt Birthday 2020 Sorcerer Mickey (LE 600), 2020 Rat zodiac Mickey & Minnie (non-sale), IWD 2022, Sept 2022 LE batch (Pluto, Oswald 95th, Teachers Day, Duffy & LinaBell [structure hold], LinaBell Magic Access); TDR Mickey balloon & Minnie 5-pin set (2021-09-29, per-design MezzoMiki), TDS20 grand finale Daisy/Arabian Coast and Donald/Mysterious Island (conflict hold), Abu's Bazaar 20th Mickey prize (prize-list hold), TDL Christmas 2022 Mickey/Minnie present pin. Claims added to reused keys: candy machine 400 Lotso / 600 Pooh (800 conflict), balloon Dopey confirmed over Goofy, Fun Day 2020 LE 800s and solar-term mystery, TDS20 framed set 6,000 yen, Halloween 2022 sets. No earlier hold released. Resellers seen and not used: usshoppingsos, fryguypins, wizmouse, dpinstore, carousell, belloshophk.
